pages.text: Cooking by hand works, but several mods let Create machines do it. $(thing)Central Kitchen$() teaches Create to use Farmer's Delight blocks. $(thing)Slice & Dice$() and $(thing)Delightful Creators$() add Create-powered cutting and kitchen recipes.

pages.title: Heat (Central Kitchen)
pages.text: A Blaze Burner under a pot or stove heats it. A hotter burner speeds up some utensils. Farmer's Delight heat sources also count as passive boiler heaters.

pages.title: Cooking Pot
pages.text: A Mechanical Arm can place the bowl and take the meal. A Funnel can pull it out. Packagers and pipes feed solid and fluid ingredients. Factory Gauges help.$(br)See $(l:create_basics/packages)Packages$(/l).

pages.title: Cutting Board
pages.text: An Arm can lay an ingredient on the board. A Deployer holding a knife in use mode cuts it, and so can a Mechanical Saw.

The $(item)Stove$() and $(item)Skillet$() accept ingredients from an Arm too.$(br2)Feasts and pies: an Arm takes servings, and the last serving stays in place until a fresh whole dish replaces it. Pancake stacks take only matching flavours, up to twelve.

pages.title: Slicer (Slice & Dice)
pages.text: A rotating cutter. Right-click it with a knife. It runs Farmer's Delight cutting board recipes, and it also works on a Basin. Needs rotation: $(l:create_basics/rotation)Rotation$(/l).

pages.title: Sprinkler
pages.text: Place it below a fluid pipe. The fluid sets the effect: Liquid Fertilizer feeds crops, potions affect mobs, lava burns, water moisturises. Not just a farm tool.

Liquid Fertilizer is mixed from tree fertilizer and water, or from Organic Compost and water. Filling Organic Compost with it makes $(item)Rich Soil$() in a Spout.$(br2)Slice & Dice also fills a bottle with Create's chocolate to make Hot Cocoa.

pages.title: Mechanical Cutter
pages.text: Delightful Creators: processes cutting board recipes on items beneath it, from a depot or belt. Cheaper to set up than a Slicer, and the same idea.

Delightful Creators also makes soups and stews $(bold)fluids$(), so a Spout can fill bowls. Many dishes (steak and potatoes, pies, sandwiches) have Sequenced Assembly versions, and cookies and cakes can be compacted. Look in JEI.
